text: dsh-wechat 将微信联系人消息接入 DSH Web：它通过腾讯 iLink bot 收取允许联系人的消息，为每位联系人创建独立会话，并把 agent 回复发回微信。插件支持文本、图片和文件输入，按联系人依次处理消息，并整理回复以适配微信气泡。适合想从微信与 DSH agent 对话、保留联系人会话上下文的用户。首次使用需扫码绑定微信账号；凭据保存在本机 DSH 状态目录。

dsh-wechat links WeChat contacts with DSH Web sessions through Tencent iLink. It receives allowed contacts’ text, images, and files, gives each contact a separate session, and sends agent replies back to WeChat. Scan a QR code to link an account; credentials are stored in local DSH storage.
我想直接在微信里给 DSH agent 发消息并收到回复。
把微信发来的图片和文件也带进对应的 agent 对话里。
Let me message my DSH agent from WeChat and get its replies in the same chat.
dsh-wechat 的功能「微信联系人会话桥接」：收到允许联系人的微信消息后，为联系人复用或创建独立 DSH 会话，等待 agent 回复并发回微信；每位联系人的消息依次处理。
dsh-wechat 的功能「转入图片和文件」：将微信消息中的图片或文件下载解密并保存为会话附件，再作为输入内容交给 agent；不支持的附件会以提示文字呈现。
dsh-wechat 使用前须知：微信消息和回复经腾讯 iLink bot 服务传输；图片和文件从微信 CDN 获取。（见 lib/client.js:125-166、lib/auth/accounts.js:15-16）
dsh-wechat 使用前须知：扫码登录后，bot token 和账号信息写入本机 DSH 状态目录的账号文件。（见 lib/client.js:84-95、lib/auth/accounts.js:170-180）

dsh-wechat README · dsh-wechat：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Bridge WeChat contacts to DeepSeek Harness sessions.

Each WeChat contact gets **its own DSH session** (`wechat-<contactId>`), so a
conversation with one person keeps its own context. Only senders on the
allowlist are served; unless you configure `allowFrom`, that is exactly the
WeChat account that completed the QR login.

text:
dsh-wechat README · Transport：The transport is Tencent's official iLink bot channel
(`https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com`) through the `@tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin`
protocol (MIT, see `LICENSE-tencent`). The protocol layer is vendored under
`src/api`, `src/cdn`, and `src/messaging`; the OpenClaw runtime glue was
replaced with harness-native equivalents (`src/util/logger.ts`,
`src/storage/state-dir.ts`, `src/auth/accounts.ts`).

dsh-wechat README · Typing indicator：While a bridged turn runs, the contact sees WeChat's native typing indicator:
the bridge fetches a typing ticket (`getConfig`), sends `sendTyping` status 1,
refreshes it every 15 seconds for the length of the turn, and cancels it right
before the reply lands. A ticket that cannot be fetched, or any `sendTyping`
failure, is logged and ignored — the indicator never costs a reply.

dsh-wechat README · Configuration (settings namespace `dsh-wechat`)：| field | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch for the message loop |
| `allowFrom` | `[]` | WeChat ids allowed to drive the agent; empty means "the linked account only" |
| `provider` / `model` | `""` | model route for bridged sessions; empty inherits the harness default |
| `cwd` | `""` | working directory for bridged sessions; empty uses this package's own directory, so sessions land in the Workspace registered for it |
| `replyAsSelf` | `false` | send replies as the linked account (`message_type: USER`) so WeChat would draw them on the right; the channel accepted those sends and delivered nothing, so it stays off |

dsh-wechat README · Login: connecting a WeChat account：Login runs **on the computer, from this package's directory** — WeChat itself only has to scan the code; there is no entry point to open inside WeChat.

**1. Install once**

```sh
cd <package dir>
pnpm install          # tsx and the other dev dependencies the login script needs
```

**2. Start the scanning page**

```sh
pnpm login
```

dsh-wechat README · Login: connecting a WeChat account：It serves a page **on this machine at <http://127.0.0.1:8899>** (refreshed every three
seconds; an expired code is replaced automatically), mirrors the code and its state into
`$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-wechat/` (`qr-content.txt`, `login-state.json`, `qr-login.png`), and
waits up to eight minutes for the scan.

**3. Scan with the phone**

dsh-wechat README · Login: connecting a WeChat account：WeChat → Discover → Scan (or “+” → Scan) → scan the code on screen → confirm the binding
on the phone. The command reports `scaned`, then `confirmed`, then prints
`LOGIN_OK account=<botId>` and stores credentials in
`$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-wechat/weixin/accounts/<botId>.json`.

**4. Restart `dsh web`** so the plugin reads the credentials.

dsh-wechat README · Login: connecting a WeChat account：**5. Start chatting** from the account you scanned with. With an empty `allowFrom`, that
account is the whole allowlist; add other WeChat ids there to let them drive the agent.

| command | purpose |
|---|---|
| `pnpm login` | scan to log in, or log in again after `errcode -14` |
| `pnpm accounts` | list the accounts stored on this machine |
| `pnpm listen` | probe-only receive loop; **never while the plugin is mounted** — one process may long-poll `getupdates` per bot token |

dsh-wechat README · Login: connecting a WeChat account：Credentials stay on the machine that logged in, under `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-wechat/weixin/`
(owner-only). This repository contains no account id, contact id, or local path.

dsh-wechat README · Known limitations：- Inbound text, images, and files are bridged — images are fetched from the CDN
  and attached to the session, files are read into it too. Voice, video, and
  forwarded cards are skipped with one warning line. Replies are plain text,
  chunked at 1800 characters.
- Only one process may long-poll `getupdates` per bot token; running the
  standalone probe while the plugin is mounted splits the message stream.
- A WeChat-driven turn cannot answer an approval prompt. Configure the
  permission and approval policy so bridged sessions do not block on one.
- `errcode -14` means the bot session expired; the plugin stops the loop and a
  new QR login is required.
